train_test_recording: Same single experimental recording; time-block holdout, not a new experimental run or unknown Reynolds number.
resampling: Bilinear velocity interpolation; retain cells whose TRAIN-derived valid-vector support is >.999; coordinates physical meters. Common grid for all methods.
normalization: TRAIN temporal mean field and per-channel fluctuation RMS only
probe_selection: TRAIN Uy variance, one fixed sensor per quadrant
original_CFD_system: Unmodified; pilot uses separately trained velocity-only FNO, TRAIN spatial residual modes and causal phase/frequency observer.
official_baseline: FLRONetFNO, unmodified official source, causal wrapper retains 4 startup full velocity fields plus latest 4 available Uy-only Voronoi frames. No future measurements relative to queried output.
FLRONet_training: batch4, 4 queried outputs per sample, measurements earlier than earliest query

baseline_configuration.capacity: Compact common-width pilot, not paper default

validation_selection: Common normalized MSE at future indices15,63,127,159 in the same validation blocks
